# Total Profit

Bulgarian brand name / alternate name: Тотал Профит

> Total Profit, also written in Bulgarian as Тотал Профит, is a Bulgarian accounting firm with an office in Sofia, providing ongoing accounting, payroll/HR administration and tax consulting, plus remote service across Bulgaria.

Canonical website: https://www.totalprofit.bg/
Language: Bulgarian (bg)
Legal entity: Тотал Профит ЕООД, EIK 208651940

## Core pages
- [Начало](https://www.totalprofit.bg/): Accounting firm in Sofia / commercial hub
- [Счетоводно обслужване](https://www.totalprofit.bg/schetovodno-obsluzhvane): Ongoing accounting services
- [Цени](https://www.totalprofit.bg/ceni): Accounting service pricing information
- [ТРЗ услуги София](https://www.totalprofit.bg/trz-uslugi-sofia): Payroll and personnel administration
- [Данъчни консултации](https://www.totalprofit.bg/danachni-konsultacii): Tax consulting
- [Регистрация на фирма](https://www.totalprofit.bg/registraciya-na-firma): Company registration support
- [ДДС регистрация](https://www.totalprofit.bg/dds-registraciya): VAT registration support
- [Годишно приключване](https://www.totalprofit.bg/godishno-priklyuchvane): Year-end accounting close
- [Данъчна защита](https://www.totalprofit.bg/danachna-zashtita): Accounting support during NRA checks and audits
- [Счетоводство за онлайн магазин](https://www.totalprofit.bg/schetovodstvo-za-onlayn-magazin): Accounting for online stores
- [Счетоводство за свободни професии](https://www.totalprofit.bg/schetovodstvo-za-svobodni-profesii): Accounting for freelancers / self-employed professionals
- [Блог](https://www.totalprofit.bg/blog): Accounting and tax blog
- [За нас](https://www.totalprofit.bg/za-nas): Company and team information
- [Контакти](https://www.totalprofit.bg/kontakti): Contact information
- [Редакционна политика](https://www.totalprofit.bg/redakcionna-politika): Editorial and automated-blog policy

## Editorial note
The blog is updated through an automated publishing workflow and rendered as first-party HTML on TotalProfit.bg. Articles are general information and are not individual accounting, tax or legal advice. Numeric thresholds, deadlines and legal references may change; use current official Bulgarian sources before acting on a specific case.
